verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community mention of a netlify.toml file with a [dev] section, plus a note about simple redirect config. That shows a project-level config file exists, but nothing shows it defines and versions the whole architecture (functions, databases, storage, env vars, domains). The same user also reports unclear docs for that file. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a single declarative config covering all architecture components, evidence that it is versioned in-repo as the source of truth, and coverage of databases/storage/secrets in that file.
